author: Zakarie Faibis
attribution: Photo: Zakarie Faibis, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vatican_Z_26.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Framed visitor panel at the Chapel of St Sebastian inside St Peter's Basilica (camera 41.90219, 12.45479, inside the basilica). The Italian header is cut by the left frame edge: a partial 'D' and full 'I' precede 'SAN SEBASTIANO' (probably 'CAPPELLA DI SAN SEBASTIANO'); only the legible part is transcribed. The cream body below is a paragraph of descriptive English text (CHAPEL OF St SEBASTIAN, CENTRE, Altar..., LEFT/RIGHT memorials) and a cut-off Italian column at left: distractors, not part of the label. Glare spot on the body text. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Chapel of Saint Sebastian in Saint Peter's Basilica
